findings.current: {from}–{to} из {totaltext} {total, plural, one {{label}} few {{plurallabel}} many {шт.} other {{plurallabel}}}
findings.proposed: source-level: give the pager genitive label forms (or a pager-specific noun pair) and use them in every branch; with the current sole caller (sessions) the text is {from}–{to} из {totaltext} {total, plural, one {сессии} few {сессий} many {сессий} other {сессии}}. A text-only branch change to {plurallabel} is not sufficient because the caller passes the nominative «сессии».
findings.reason: The many branch (5-20, 25-30, …) ignores the caller's {plurallabel} and emits the literal «шт.», and the few/other branches emit the caller's nominative plural, so the pager renders «1–10 из 50 шт.» and «1–3 из 3 сессии» instead of the genitive «сессий». The only caller passes label=«сессия», plurallabel=«сессии» (analytics-panel.tsx:687-694), so the current branches cannot form the genitive Russian requires; {label} is a defined placeholder present in every English branch.
findings.evidence: Rendered with IntlMessageFormat at total=50: «1–10 из 50 шт.»; at total=3: «1–3 из 3 сессии». Source-level alternative: pass genitive forms (or a pager-specific noun pair) into the primitive and use {plurallabel} in every branch.

findings.reason: The completion wave dropped «всего:», leaving a bare nominative fragment after the semicolon; the English «N of M did not report» relation is no longer explicit. {plural} is the label-first plural() output (e.g. «рантаймы: 3»), so the proposed label-first shape reads «рантаймы: 3 · без ответа: 2» and matches the other label-first status lines.
findings.evidence: Rendered: «Без ответа: 2; рантаймы: 3». Wave diff: «Без ответа: 2; всего: 3 …» → current.

findings.proposed: {count, plural, one {лимит модели исчерпан} few {лимита моделей исчерпаны} many {лимитов моделей исчерпано} other {лимита моделей исчерпано}}
findings.reason: statsTerms renders `${term.count} ${term.label}` (usage-view-model.ts:724-774), so the label must inflect after the externally prepended numeral. The few/many branches use nominative plural «лимиты», producing «2 лимиты моделей исчерпаны» / «5 лимиты моделей исчерпаны»; the proposed forms produce «2 лимита моделей исчерпаны» / «5 лимитов моделей исчерпано».
findings.evidence: Rendered tally term at count=2: «2 лимиты моделей исчерпаны»; at count=5: «5 лимиты моделей исчерпаны».

findings.current: {count, plural, one {указан баланс} few {указаны балансы} many {указаны балансы} other {указан баланс}}
findings.proposed: {count, plural, one {указанный баланс} few {указанных баланса} many {указанных балансов} other {указанного баланса}}
findings.reason: Same externally prepended count: «2 указаны балансы» is ungrammatical; an agreeing noun phrase gives «2 указанных баланса» / «5 указанных балансов».
findings.evidence: Rendered tally term at count=2: «2 указаны балансы»; at count=5: «5 указаны балансы».

findings.reason: The tally prepends the count, so the masculine singular short adjective reads «2 исчерпан» / «2 почти исчерпан». Neuter short forms are invariant in this telegraphic tally («1 исчерпано», «2 исчерпано», «5 исчерпано»); a source-side plural would be cleaner but is not needed for grammatical output.
findings.evidence: statsTerms composition at count=2: «2 исчерпан · 2 почти исчерпан».

findings.reason: Russian one covers 21/31/101, so the one branch renders the singular label with a plural count («рантайм: 21») while every other count gets the plural label. Using {pluralnoun} in the one branch as well gives the consistent label-first «рантаймы: 21». The prior round-2 minor remains open at the current bytes.

The locale uses «вход» for sign-in everywhere else (Выполнен вход, Состояние входа, Войти в учётную запись), and this is now the only «авторизац» left in the audited namespace. The prior round-2 minor remains open.

findings.proposed: source-level: pass the bound inside the trajectory phrase, e.g. {runtimecount} · траектории: {bound}{count}, or drop {bound} from this composite
findings.reason: {trajectorycount} is already the label-first plural() output («траектории: 12»), so prefixing {bound} yields «≥траектории: 12» in the rare unreported state. The prior round-2 minor remains open.
«д» is not a conventional Russian abbreviation for days in this locale («мин» and «ч» are conventional); «дн.» is the standard form.

The finite plural «Забыли» reads as a personal «you/they forgot» and breaks the impersonal status register used by the sibling toasts («сохранено», «работа возобновлена»); the style guide prefers impersonal constructions.

The MAJOR is the table pager's hardcoded «шт.» and wrong genitive in every non-empty branch; ICU structure, placeholders, number/date skeletons and plural categories are clean. The minors are wording, case and consistency defects recorded for one remediation round, not blockers.
